summary: Visual Studio Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness, the older software that coordinates the model, context, and tools for GitHub Copilot agent sessions in the editor. The Local harness will be removed in February 2027.
takeaways: Why use the Copilot harness Built on the Copilot SDK , the Copilot harness shares its coding-agent runtime with Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app.
If you access models through GitHub Copilot, you can continue to use your existing plan, including Copilot Free.
However, new features and improvements will focus on the Copilot harness.
